title: Algorithmic Trading & Signal System
shortDescription: A Python algorithmic trading and signal research system engineered exclusively for XAUUSDm, featuring causal market-structure analysis (BOS/CHoCH), multi-gate confluence validation, risk controls, MetaTrader 5 integration, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
longDescription: A Python-based algorithmic trading and signal research system built around the MetaTrader 5 platform, focused exclusively on gold (XAUUSDm). The project is structured as a modular pipeline for market-data processing, causal market-structure analysis (Break of Structure / Change of Character), multi-gate confluence validation, strict risk controls, and structured trade logging. It was developed as a B.Tech capstone project to investigate causal market structure, fair-value gaps, liquidity runs, and multi-timeframe validation with engineering rigor and diagnostic hypothesis tracking.
problem: Retail trading systems often suffer from ungrounded discretionary logic, opaque execution behavior, poor risk management, and unverified multi-timeframe signals that are difficult to backtest and debug.
solution: Built a modular Python research and execution system tailored exclusively for XAUUSDm that isolates data ingestion, causal market-structure analysis (BOS/CHoCH), multi-gate confluence scoring, volatility-based risk controls, and PostgreSQL trade logging.
architecture: Python application organized around a central orchestrator with separate modules for market-data processing, market-structure analysis, risk management, and structured logging. MetaTrader 5 serves as the execution and live tick/bar ingestion environment, while PostgreSQL persists trade records and diagnostic outputs for offline analysis.
features: Exclusively engineered for XAUUSDm gold market dynamics
Causal market-structure analysis detecting BOS (Break of Structure) and CHoCH (Change of Character)
Multi-gate confluence validation scoring combining market structure, fair-value gaps, and session timing
Volatility-adaptive risk controls, stop-loss calculations, and partial-take-profit logic
MetaTrader 5 integration for live tick/bar ingestion and order execution
PostgreSQL persistence for trade records, signal logs, and diagnostic analysis
Dockerized environment for reproducible backtesting and execution
challenges: Translating discretionary trading concepts into deterministic, testable modules
Managing state and position tracking across MetaTrader 5 bar events
Designing logging and diagnostics that reveal discrepancies between expected and observed behavior
lessonsLearned: Modular architecture makes it possible to isolate and test individual strategy components
Structured logging is as important as the trading logic for understanding system behavior
Risk management and debugging infrastructure deserve as much design attention as signal generation
futureImprovements: Automated performance reporting and hypothesis tracking
